name: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
description:
About This Game

In Cardaire: Eternal Aces you play as "Mulligan" as she embarks on a strange adventure in a world that runs on the power of trading cards. Expand your collection by hunting down cards or purchasing booster packs. Once you've gathered your cards, craft your own unique deck to overcome the powerful duelists you encounter on your journey.

This game is planned to include:

  • Over 200 unique cards

  • An expanded deck editor, including multiple deck slots and the ability to export/import deck lists

  • An updated duel UI that runs smoother than a pack fresh card

  • Difficult rivals and unique bosses to defeat

  • A world to explore that's not too hard on the eyes

  • Some relaxing fishing content

This game will not include:

  • AI Art

  • NFTs

  • Microtransactions

  • A clown (probably. honestly I haven't checked.)

You're still reading the store page? Even when this section has the boring label of "About Me"? Well bless your soul, take a seat and I'll tell you a tale.

This tale begins with a young aeiou (that's me!). I grew up obsessed with every trading card game I could get my hands on. Eventually I stumbled into video game versions of those card games, and fell in love with them. The experience of starting from nothing, exploring a world to find more cards for your deck, and slowly becoming an absolute menace with a deck full of over powered cards.

Well that's the kind of game I'm trying to create here, so I hope that sounds interesting to you! I'm working on C:EA as a solo dev so there's quite a lot of work to do, but it's worth it to get more of these digital cardboard simulators out into the world!
short_desc: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in Cardaire: Eternal Aces, a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world, hunt down powerful cards, and build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.
